entries.title: Psalms 85:1
segments: This psalm is referred by many to the time when the restoration of the Jewish state after the Babylonish captivity was in progress, but not yet completed, and many trials and difficulties remained to be encountered.  The writer first thanks God for the good work which he has begun, and then prays that he would remove the present severe pressure of trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 85:2
segments:
Covered; that is, by forgiveness. 
 
All needed blessings are through grace connected with the forgiveness of sin, without which nothing will avail to salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 85:4
segments: Turn us; restore us to our former prosperity.  In the mind of a pious Israelite, such restoration always included the idea of repentance and reformation.

entries.title: Psalms 85:6
segments:
Revive us again; by thy life-giving presence and favor.  The reviving for which the psalmist prays, includes both the spiritual and the temporal prosperity of Israel, which were inseparably connected with each other. 
 
God is the source of all prosperity, national and individual, spiritual and temporal.  Men are dependent upon him for "every good and perfect gift;" especially for the beginning and increase of true religion and the salvation connected with it.

entries.title: Psalms 85:8
segments:
To folly; especially to idolatry and its vices. 
 
God will not spare the sins of his covenant people.  If they would receive a gracious answer to their prayers, they must repent of their folly and return to it no more.

entries.title: Psalms 85:10
segments:
Mercy and truth are met together; they harmonize in the dealings of God, especially in his method of forgiving sin and saving sinners through the Redeemer. 
 
All the attributes of God harmonize in his dealings with men, especially in the way in which he delivers them from hell and prepares them for heaven.

entries.title: Psalms 85:11
segments:
Spring out of the earth; like an abundant harvest. 
 
  Righteousness shall look down from heaven; as a friend and helper. The reference is to God's truth and righteousness, as manifested in the fulfilment of his engagements to his covenant people.

entries.title: Psalms 85:13
segments: The way of his steps; lead us to imitate his example.
